blockers.error: NEF Nikon Huffman compression 34713 (D70s lossy type 1, Z6 12-bit compressed): no public documentation of the Huffman trees or the MakerNote 0x8C/0x96 curve layout found (libopenraw formats/nef and Bill Claff NEF_Compression describe only the scheme; both point to dcraw source, which R1 forbids)

ARW2 cRAW (Sony compression 32767, ILCE-7S): public descriptions (Dietz EI2016 slides, MIT FLIF sony_arw README) give the scheme (16-pixel groups, 11-bit max/min, positions, 7-bit deltas, 5-segment curve 0x7010) but not the exact bit layout/shift rule; the README tool is GPLv3 (dcraw-derived). Needs a lead decision: may the builder read rawkit (MIT/Apache, brief R1 a/b names it as permissive reference) or must ARW wait for R1 (c) dnglab oracle-driven black-box derivation?

ORF C5060WZ (only ORF sample): IIRS-magic TIFF-like, IFD0 2608x1949 12-bit Compression 1, but strips are not TIFF-conformant (RowsPerStrip 16 = 62592 bytes, yet several strips declare 58680 bytes = 15 rows with 59904-byte spacing); the layout is not publicly documented, so a decode would be a guess. Also tiff.rs (read-only for this lane) refuses non-42 magic, so ORF needs a patched-header copy or the interop-tiff owner.
RW2 LX7: Panasonic compression (tag 0x0b = 34316, ~9.2 bits/pixel); no public format documentation of the codec found

RAF: container documented (libopenraw formats/raf: header, offset directory, meta records 0x100/0x110/0x111/0x121/0x130/0x131), but S5000 is SuperCCD (diagonal sensor; stored 16-bit grid 2160x1472 is not a Bayer/X-Trans CfaPattern; remap undocumented) and X-S10 is Fuji-compressed X-Trans (codec undocumented publicly). A container-only parser would still end in a typed refusal; not built.
CR3/CRX: brief schedules it last and requires Operator re-evaluation against R1 (c) before building (CRX wavelet codec has no public spec); not started

next: lead decisions: (1) ARW route (rawkit as reference, or dnglab black-box derivation by a different builder); (2) independent DNG oracle run (dnglab convert or Adobe DNG Converter, by validator/Operator) for the CR2 350D and NEF D1H CFA samples + pattern; (3) DNG 5D3 LJPEG-shape finding to the SMB-DEVELOP lane; (4) CR3 per brief with the Operator
